title: The platforms a door elsewhere may name (vocab/door-platforms.json)

reserved_subdomains.description: Names under a platform's host that are the platform's own (help, app, admin…), never a business's.

reserved_paths.description: First path segments that are a platform's own pages (login, pricing, blog…), never a business's.

id.description: The token a doors_elsewhere entry names, and a door type platform:<id>.

hosts.description: Registrable names: a host is on the platform when it is one of these or a name under one.

page.description: How the business's own page is told apart on a platform with no pages: a path other than / whose first segment is not reserved, a name under the host other than www and the reserved names, or either.

pages.description: Where the platform's pages for a business are known to sit: patterns, matched without regard to case against the host without www. followed by the path. With them, a page there is the business's own only when one matches.

own_site.description: The platform also serves the business's pages on the business's own domain, named there by their host.

source.description: The platform's own public page or help the hosts were read from.
